title: Software Engineer II, AdTech Campaigns - Vendor (Application-Engineer/-Manager/in)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are looking for a Software Engineer II (Golang) to join our AdTech tribe. You'll help build our next-generation advertising platform that helps partners – restaurants and local shops – promote their best dishes, attract new customers, and grow their business. If you enjoy solving concrete engineering problems, growing your ownership over real production systems, and learning from a senior, distributed team, this is a great next step – and Berlin is waiting for you.

You'll join the squad owning a critical piece of the AdTech ecosystem: the Campaigns Squad, which powers the creation and management of campaigns across all Delivery Hero brands globally, and the Advertiser Service, the central solution for advertiser data. You will contribute to the scalability, performance, and resilience of these services as part of a squad supporting a global user base.

- Own and deliver well-scoped features end-to-end within the Campaigns and Advertiser services, from design input through to production.
- Write clean, well-tested, maintainable Go code that meets the team's engineering and security standards.
- Contribute to architecture and design discussions for the features you build, with guidance from senior engineers.
- Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other squads across the AdTech tribe to ship reliable solutions.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across the services you help maintain, escalating and learning as needed.
- Participate actively in code reviews, estimations, and team ceremonies, and keep growing your technical and business understanding.

Qualifications

- 2+ years of professional software development experience, with solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
- Hands-on experience with Go (or strong proficiency in another backend language plus a genuine interest in Go) and a good understanding of service-oriented / microservices patterns.
- Experience with relational (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
- Some exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Docker, and Kubernetes, and a willingness to deepen this knowledge.
- A quality-first mindset: you write tests, care about readability, and are comfortable asking for and giving feedback in code reviews.
- Good communication skills and fluent English.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym Subsidy.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

title: Retail Program Specialist (m/w/d) - Berlin (Kaufmann/-frau - Marketingkommunikation)
description:
What to Expect

Tesla's retail stores are more than sales floors, they are the physical expression of our brand, our products, and our mission. As Regional Retail Program Specialist you will support the connection between EMEA retail marketing strategy and real customer experience on the ground. As part of the Central Europe Sales Operations team, you will work alongside the Customer Engagement, CX, Infradev, and local store teams to help ensure that every program, every asset, and every touchpoint tells a consistent, curated story from the moment a customer walks in the door.This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role that requires presence in market. You will travel regularly within Central Europe to support program rollouts, conduct brand standard checks, and build the kind of trusted local relationships that help EMEA strategy land.

What You’ll Do

- Support the consistent implementation of brand standards across all locations in Central Europe
- Support the implementation of retail programs in market, including new product launches, seasonal campaigns, and evergreen initiatives
- Coordinate retail refresh initiatives and brand asset distribution across locations in Central Europe
- Conduct regular store standard checks across each location and report field observations, learnings, and local market dynamics to the relevant teams
- Support and inform different stakeholders on new and existing store developments, helping ensure retail standards and educational elements are integrated
- Support the piloting of new retail concepts and sales tools locally, and help facilitate best practice sharing across markets
- Build and maintain comprehensive database of brand assets and equipment for each location in Central Europe

What You’ll Bring

- 1–2 years of experience in retail marketing, operations, or a related field - ideally within a consumer brand, automotive, or tech environment
- Good understanding of in-store brand experience, consumer journey, and retail standards
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, with support from senior team members
- Highly collaborative - comfortable working across functions including marketing, operations, design, and facilities
- Organised and detail-oriented, with a hands-on approach to execution and follow-through
- Willingness and ability to travel regularly within Central Europe — this role requires a consistent in-market presence
- Proficiency in German & English; additional regional language is a plus

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.

Apply at: https://www.tesla.com/careers/search/job/278301?source=BA

title: Trainee / Specialist – Technical Presales & Geospatial Solutions (m/f/d) (Wirtschaftsingenieur/in)
description:

Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support)

Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents

Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required)

About the Research Institute:

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) bridges the gap between scientific spatial data research and practical implementation, identifying and evaluating high-value strategic sites for energy storage systems and digital infrastructure.

What We Offer:

We provide complete end-to-end support for international candidates under the German Opportunity Card system, including official paperwork, degree validation, housing assistance, and living allowances during the trainee phase. On-site German language courses and direct involvement in high-impact energy infrastructure initiatives are part of the package.

Your Role & Key Tasks:

You will translate spatial data analyses and infrastructure parameters into structured location dossiers and automated B2B lead profiles. You will support technical communications with project partners and institutional stakeholders, while capturing practical industry feedback to continuously refine our spatial queries and research algorithms.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications:

Applicants should possess a completed degree in Business Engineering, Spatial Economics, Real Estate, Spatial Planning, or Geoinformatics with a commercial mindset. You must have strong communication and organizational skills, an ability to interpret infrastructure maps and site metrics, and fluent English skills.

How to Apply:

Please submit your CV and a short cover letter in English. We look forward to welcoming you to our initiative! Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter in English directly to:

jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

title: Trainee / Specialist – Data Mining & Web Scraping Automation (m/f/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH)

Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support)

Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents

Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required)

About the Research Institute:

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) conducts applied research into spatial data systems, automated data extraction, and infrastructure transformation. We build scalable data pipelines to turn fragmented public records into structured spatial insights.

What We Offer:

We fully sponsor and support your relocation journey to Germany via the Opportunity Card framework, managing visa formalities, degree assessments, and onboarding logistics. You will benefit from organized accommodation, living allowances during training, sponsored German language classes, and hands-on exposure to production-grade data mining environments.

Your Role & Key Tasks:

You will design, develop, and maintain autonomous scraping routines and extraction agents for public registers, corporate filings, and official announcements. You will parse complex unstructured document formats—such as HTML, PDF, JSON, and XML—into clean, relational data structures, while monitoring data feeds and integrating incoming datasets into our core spatial repositories.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications:

Applicants should hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related technical subject. You should possess solid foundations or a strong motivation to develop your skills in Python (using libraries such as Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, or Playwright), text parsing, regex, and structured data modelling. Fluent English is required.

How to Apply:

Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter in English. We look forward to reviewing your application! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

title: Trainee / Specialist – Geospatial Data Engineering & Spatial Pipelines (m/f/d) (Geoinformatiker/in)
description:
Organization: IRIS – Institut für raumbezogene Infrastruktur und Raumforschung (gGmbH)

Location: Germany (On-site / Hybrid with Relocation & Housing Support)

Target Program: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte) / Master Trainees / International Talents

Working Language: English (No initial German language skills required)

About the Research Institute:

The IRIS Institute (gGmbH) is a non-profit, applied research institute dedicated to developing cutting-edge spatial resilience data models and open-data architectures for the energy transition, critical infrastructure, and sustainable regional planning.

What We Offer:

We provide comprehensive administrative support for international candidates, including full assistance with the German Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte), degree recognition, and visa procedures. You will receive structured onboarding, local accommodation support, coverage of basic living expenses during training, on-site sponsored German language courses, and access to a modern data engineering tech stack centered on Python, PostGIS, Docker, and GIS platforms.

Your Role & Key Tasks:

In this role, you will build and maintain automated Python-based spatial data pipelines connecting to WFS services, REST APIs, and public open-data platforms. You will implement spatial overlay and inference models for energy grid matching and land-use analysis, while validating, structuring, and transforming vector geometries into our central PostgreSQL and PostGIS databases.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications:

We welcome applicants with a completed university degree in Geoinformatics, Computer Science, Data Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical discipline. You should bring practical experience or a strong learning interest in Python (GeoPandas, Shapely), SQL databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS), spatial reference systems, and automated data ingestion workflows. High motivation and fluent English skills are required.

How to Apply:

Please submit your CV along with a short cover letter in English. We look forward to welcoming you to the IRIS team! jobs@iris-institut.info (https://mailto:jobs@iris-institut.info)

title: International Product Specialist Diagnostics Southeast Asia (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Internationale Wirtschaft)
description:
Why Löwenstein Medical?

What you do here makes a difference.
For 40 years, we have been developing and manufacturing medical technology that saves lives and improves quality of life. Around the world, our products and services support patients who depend on reliable respiratory care, helping them regain greater independence and well-being. Thanks to the dedication of our employees across all areas of the company, we have become one of the leading providers of medical technology solutions for hospital and homecare settings. Work where your contribution matters.
No matter what role you take on at Löwenstein Medical, your work helps make high-quality healthcare possible and contributes to improving the lives of patients every day.

Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate, support, and execute international sleep diagnostics projects from procurement planning through to routine operation, serving both B2B and B2C customers in close collaboration with the International Homecare Sales Team.
- Support and oversee product evaluations, pilot projects, and test installations at customer sites.
- Plan, organize, and deliver customer training sessions, workshops, and educational events.
- Develop and implement sleep diagnostics concepts for new international markets in cooperation with the International Homecare Sales Team.
- Manage and develop relationships with existing international customers, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
- Provide and coordinate first- and second-level technical support for customers and partners.
- Prepare and deliver product presentations, demonstrations, and training sessions for international audiences.
- Plan, coordinate, and participate in international trade fairs, congresses, and industry conferences.
- Collect and analyze market-specific product requirements and customer needs and systematically communicate findings to the Product Development team.
- Gather marketing-related requirements and market insights from international regions and coordinate their implementation with the Marketing team.
- Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and new product developments in the field of sleep diagnostics and homecare.
- Analyze and track competitor activities, products, and market strategies.
- Prepare regular reports and business updates for the company headquarters in Germany

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree (or comparable education) in Medical Technology, Biomedical Engineering, or a comparable field.
- Proven experience working in an international environment within the medical technology industry.
- Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable: sleep diagnostics, sleep apnea therapy, respiratory care, or neurophysiology.
- Strong intercultural competence with the ability to adapt to diverse cultures, working styles, and business environments.
- Flexibility regarding working hours to support international operations and customer needs.
- Excellent command of English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Highly self-motivated with a proactive, solution-oriented, and independent approach to work.
- Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build and maintain professional relationships.
- Sound knowledge of IT systems, networking technologies, and medical/anatomical concepts related to sleep diagnostics and homecare applications.
- Confident and professional presenter with experience delivering product demonstrations, customer training, and educational workshops.

What we offer

- A secure position with a leading family-owned medical technology company
- Comprehensive onboarding and individual training opportunities
- Flexible working hours and attractive work-life balance options
- A collaborative working environment with short decision-making processes
- Long-term career development opportunities
- The opportunity to contribute to improving patients' quality of life every day

Ready to make a difference?

As an independent family-owned business, we stand for stability, reliability, and a long-term perspective. We finance our growth through our own resources and focus on sustainable success rather than short-term profit targets. Family values, mutual respect, and a collaborative working environment are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that lasting success is achieved through strong teams and people who take ownership, act responsibly, and support one another. If these values resonate with you, we would be delighted to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Niedersachsen - Pflegefachkraft Kinderintensivpflege (m/w/d) - JOB ID 1961 (Fachkinderkrankenpfleger/in - Intensivpflege/Anästhesie)
description:
Individuelle Jobvermittlung für Ihren nächsten Karriere-Step
Sie suchen neue berufliche Herausforderungen? Wir sind Ihr diskreter Partner für den perfekten Job. Verlässlich schaffen wir bundesweit, berufliche Verbindungen zwischen Spezialisten  Führungskräften und den passenden Unternehmen.
Ihr Vorteil: Wir finden für Sie kostenfrei den idealen Karriere-Fit!

Sie möchten Kindern Zeit schenken statt ständig gegen die Uhr zu arbeiten?
In der außerklinischen Kinderintensivpflege steht nicht der nächste Klingelruf im Mittelpunkt, sondern der einzelne Mensch. Hier begleiten Sie Kinder und Jugendliche in ihrem Alltag, bauen Vertrauen auf und erleben Pflege in einer Umgebung, in der Nähe, Zeit und Kontinuität selbstverständlich sind.

Warum diese Position spannend ist
Sie arbeiten in einer ambulanten Intensivpflege-Wohngruppe für Kinder und Jugendliche und betreuen Ihre jungen Patientinnen und Patienten mit einem außergewöhnlich hohen Personalschlüssel von 1:2. Dadurch bleibt Zeit für individuelle Pflege, persönliche Beziehungen und eine Betreuung, die sich konsequent an den Bedürfnissen der Kinder orientiert.
Gleichzeitig erwartet Sie eine angenehme Alternative zum oft hektischen Klinikalltag.

Was Sie hier erwartet
Gemeinsam mit einem multiprofessionellen Team begleiten Sie Kinder und Jugendliche im Alltag und übernehmen die intensivpflegerische Versorgung in einer familiären Wohnumgebung. Sie arbeiten eng mit Ärztinnen, Ärzten, Therapeutinnen, Therapeuten sowie den Angehörigen zusammen und tragen aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung der Pflegequalität bei.

Ihr fachlicher Schwerpunkt
Zu Ihrem Aufgabenbereich gehören unter anderem:

Außerklinische Kinderintensivpflege
Individuelle Pflege und Betreuung
Zusammenarbeit mit Angehörigen
Teilnahme an ärztlichen Visiten
Kooperation mit Therapeutinnen, Therapeuten und Providern
Qualitätsmanagement
Pflegeprozessplanung
Umsetzung aktueller pflegewissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse

Ihre Verantwortung

Sie übernehmen die intensivpflegerische Versorgung von Kindern und Jugendlichen.
Sie gestalten individuelle Pflege- und Betreuungsprozesse.
Sie arbeiten eng mit Angehörigen sowie allen beteiligten Berufsgruppen zusammen.
Sie unterstützen die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Pflegequalität.
Sie bringen aktuelle pflegefachliche Erkenntnisse in den Alltag ein.
Sie fördern eine vertrauensvolle und familiäre Atmosphäre für die jungen Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner.

Was Sie mitbringen

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d)
Interesse an der außerklinischen Kinderintensivpflege
Bereitschaft zur Fachweiterbildung Außerklinische Intensivpflege
Empathie und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
Teamfähigkeit sowie selbstständige Arbeitsweise
Freude an einer langfristigen Begleitung von Kindern und Jugendlichen

Warum sich ein Wechsel lohnt

Außerklinische Intensivpflege statt hektischer Klinikalltag
Sehr hoher Betreuungsschlüssel von 1:2
Familiäre Wohngruppe mit langfristiger Patientenbegleitung
Strukturierte und umfassende Einarbeitung
Fachweiterbildung Außerklinische Intensivpflege
Umfangreiche interne und externe Fortbildungen
Großer Gestaltungsspielraum
Tarifgebundene Vergütung mit Jahressonderzahlung
35 Urlaubstage, ab dem 30. Lebensjahr 36 Urlaubstage
Weihnachten und Silvester ohne zusätzlichen Urlaubsabzug
Wertschätzendes interdisziplinäres Team

title: Pflegedienstleitung (m/w/d) mit Empathie und Fachkompetenz (Pflegedienstleiter/in)
description:
Weil wir #pflegeleben!

Pflegedienstleitung (m/w/d) mit Empathie und Fachkompetenz für unsere Diakonie-Station Zehlendorf-West

Die Diakonie-Station Zehlendorf-West – ein engagiertes Team inmitten des charmanten Berliner Stadtteils. Wir schätzen die Nähe zum idyllischen Schlachtensee und der Krummen Lanke in unserem familienfreundlichen Bezirk. Werde Teil unserer familiären Gemeinschaft und gestalte die Pflege von morgen!

Komm ins Team Diakonie!

Was bietet dir unsere Diakonie-Station Zehlendorf-West in Berlin:

- Wir zahlen nach Tarif AVR DWBO (https://www.diakonie-portal.de/ueber-uns/arbeitsrecht/arbeitsrechtliche-kommission-ak/arbeitsvertragsrichtlinien-des-diakonischen-werkes-berlin-brandenburg-schlesische-oberlausitz-avr-dwbo) (EG10).
- Eine Vollzeit-Woche hat bei uns nur 38,5 Stunden.
- Je nach Erfahrung beträgt dein Verdienst 4.931 € bis 5.450 €/Monat - mit längerer Zugehörigkeit zum Unternehmen werden es bis zu 5.969 €/Monat. Dazu kommen:
- regelmäßige Tariferhöhungen,
- eine Jahressonderzahlung bis zur Höhe eines 13. Monatsgehalts (abhängig vom Betriebsergebnis),
- ein Zuschlag von bis zu 88 € pro Kind für Kindergeldberechtigte.
- Zu unseren starken Sozialleistungen gehört eine arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge.
- Du bekommst 31 Tage Urlaub.
- Eine rücksichtsvolle Dienst- und Urlaubsplanung liegt uns am Herzen.
- Fort- und Weiterbildungen, auch mit unserem "Pflegecampus" eLearning ‒ individuell, persönlich, ortsunabhängig.

Dein Aufgabengebiet:

Als Pflegedienstleitung (m/w/d) bist du für den Standort Diakonie-Station Zehlendorf-West in Berlin verantwortlich. Du übernimmst fachliche und organisatorische Leitungsaufgaben und führst dein Team mit Empathie, Klarheit und verantwortungsbewusster Hand.

Dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung sind gefragt:

- Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Arbeit und sorgst für ein reibungsloses Vertrags- und Verordnungsmanagement.
- Du pflegst die Korrespondenz mit Kostenträgern und hältst alle organisatorischen Fäden in der Hand.
- Für die Pflegedokumentation nutzt du unsere moderne Software .snap von euregon®, die dir die Arbeit erleichtert.

Als Ansprechperson für neue Pflegekundschaft, deren Angehörige und Zugehörige bist du oft der erste freundliche Kontakt – du übernimmst Erstaufnahmen und schaffst Vertrauen von Anfang an.

Darüber hinaus bist du in engem Austausch mit Ärztinnen und Ärzten, Therapeuten und -innen, Fachkliniken und den sozialen Diensten. Auch in schwierigen Situationen stehst du unserer Pflegekundschaft mit Ruhe, Verständnis und Lösungsorientierung zur Seite.

Pflegedienstleitung (m/w/d) - das bringst du mit:

Formale Voraussetzungen:

- Du bist examinierte Fachkraft* in der Pflege und hast eine Weiterbildungsmaßnahme für leitende Funktionen mit mind. 460 Stunden abgeschlossen.
- In den letzten 8 Jahren hast du mindestens 2 Jahre lang als Pflegefachkraft gearbeitet, davon mindestens 9 Monate ambulant.

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Eine zeitgemäße Personalführung liegt dir am Herzen.
- In einem Tätigkeitsfeld mit Verantwortungs- und Gestaltungsspielraum fühlst du dich wohl.
- Betriebswirtschaftliche Grundlagen bringst du mit.
- In den gängigen Office Software Anwendungen bist du sicher.
- Wir freuen uns, wenn du deine Ideen einbringst und unsere Einrichtung positiv mitgestaltest.

Eine bestimmte Konfession ist nicht notwendig.

*Pflegefachkraft, Pflegefachperson, Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann, Krankenpfleger oder Krankenpflegerin/Krankenschwester, Altenpfleger oder Altenpflegerin

Das ist uns sehr wichtig!

Welche ethnische oder soziale Herkunft du hast, welche geschlechtliche Identität du lebst, welche Religion du praktizierst, welche sexuelle Orientierung du hast, wie alt du bist oder ob du eine Schwerbehinderung oder Gleichstellung hast, ist für uns egal, denn ...

... wo Du auch herkommst, bei uns kommst Du an!

Uns ist aber wichtig, dass du unsere Werte teilst - unser Leitbild findest du hier. (https://www.diakonie-pflege.de/leitbild)

Deine Einarbeitung:

Dein neues Team freut sich auf dich und damit alles klappt, wirst du natürlich gründlich in unsere Systeme eingearbeitet.

In den ersten Wochen geht es darum, dich mit den Abläufen vertraut zu machen und dir unser tolles Team vorzustellen. Wir sind dabei immer an deiner Seite!

Zögerst du deine Bewerbung abzusenden?

Karrierechancen, Weiterbildungen und Qualifikationen, mögliche Arbeitszeiten oder auch Einsatzorte - in einem Gespräch lässt sich vieles klären. Sprich uns an!

Gerne kannst du auch einen Schnuppertag bei uns machen oder einfach hospitieren.

Du möchtest zu uns wechseln?

Falls du dich in einem ungekündigten Arbeitsverhältnis befindest, sichern wir dir natürlich höchste Vertraulichkeit deiner Bewerbung zu.

So geht es mit deiner Bewerbung als Pflegedienstleitung (m/w/d) weiter:

1. Du bewirbst dich hier online als Pflegedienstleitung (m/w/d) in der Diakonie-Station Zehlendorf-West in Berlin, indem du auf den "Jetzt online bewerben"-Button klickst. Nutze bei Fragen vorab den E-Mail- oder WhatsApp-Kontakt der genannten Ansprechperson.
2. Wir überprüfen deine Informationen und Dokumente und melden uns bei Unklarheiten. Gerne informieren wir auch allgemein über unsere Einrichtung oder auch zu unserem Tarifsystem.
3. Wenn alle benötigten Informationen bei uns sind, meldet sich die jeweilige Einrichtung bei dir, um dich persönlich kennen zu lernen und macht mit dir einen Kennlerntermin. Dann werden alle Einzelheiten besprochen.

Klingt das gut? Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Pflegedienstleitung (m/w/d) und klicke auf "Jetzt online bewerben".

description:

- Analysis and derivation of Mission and System performance parameters

- Conception, design, development and validation of SW packages for Mission Analysis and Flight Dynamics purposes.
- Development of optimal / suboptimal Attitude Guidance profiles
- Computation of nominal mission profiles.
- Development of Orbit Control strategies and related SW
- Derivation of Mission-related requirements.
Your Qualifications

- Master’s or doctoral degree or equivalent in Engineering, Physics or Mathematics.
- Deep and hands-on knowledge on Orbital Dynamics problems and methods.
- Ability and experience to apply theoretical knowledge for the solution of technical problems in Space Flight Dynamics.
- Experience in the use of numerical methods for Orbit Determination and Control.
- Experience as FD engineer in operational context is a plus.
- Good knowledge of satellite Attitude Kinematics and Dynamics.
- Knowledge and experience in optimization theory is a plus.
- Ability to work in cooperation with Systems and Subsystems Engineers in multidisciplinary teams.
- Excellent command in MATLAB and Python. C and System Tool Kit (STK) are a plus.

title: Territory Sales Manager Crop Care (m/f/d) (Sales-Manager/in)
description:
Ref. 121810– Territory Sales Manager Crop Care (m/f/d)

NOTHING RUNS LIKE A DEERE!

We manage our international sales activities and promote our smart product with the right marketing focus at our location in Walldorf. Around 400 employees face these challenges on site or in the field. #wearewalldorf  

The Crop Care & Precision Tech organization is looking for a

Territory Sales Manager Crop Care (m/f/d) in Germany

Our new Crop Care & Precision Tech team won’t just be selling equipment, we’ll be selling innovative products and solutions which deliver better agronomic and economic outcomes for our customers. As a Territory Sales Manager Crop Care your focus will be on driving sales growth and customer adoption of John Deere Crop Care solutions across your assigned territory. This role combines customer-facing sales execution, dealer enablement and strategic territory planning to accelerate market share growth and strengthen John Deere’s position in Crop Care solutions. You will be collaborating with other members of the John Deere field team and our channel partners to manage the sales funnel for your assigned products, identifying and qualifying target customers, developing customer-specific solutions and supporting dealers on key opportunities from prospecting through closing.

What You´ll Get:

- modern and flexible working, part-time options, shared-leadership and much more
- excellent benefits, such as employer-funded occupational pension / life cover / income protection benefits
- further benefits such as subsidized Company Bike, FamPlus and much more
- an attractive compensation package including variable pay program

In addition to the gross monthly salary, the salary for this position (full-time) consists of various special payments. Depending on your experience, you can expect an annual starting salary of between 84 907 and 106 134 EUR in this position.

**Your Responsibilities:**

- Execute the Crop Care sales funnel and actively manage opportunities within your territory
- Identify and prioritize target customers and growth opportunities with a focus on large and progressive farming operations
- Collaborate with John Deere dealers to develop, qualify and close sales opportunities
- Maintain high-quality Crop Care CRM data and ensure accurate pipeline management and forecasting
- Implement differentiated sales and demo activities by leveraging a strong production system argumentation.
- Support dealers throughout the sales process including customer visits, value argumentation and offer development
- Work closely between Production Systems, Horst Factory and the dealer network to jointly accelerate Corp Care Sales and our customers’ experience.
- Lead solution development activities by aligning customer needs with John Deere Crop Care products and technologies by understanding customer needs and matching those with John Deere Crop Care products and technologies
- Analyze market trends, competitive activities and customer needs to identify additional growth opportunities
- Provide insights and feedback to Product Management, Marketing and Leadership teams to support future business development

**What Skills You Need:**

- Strong understanding of agricultural production systems and crop care solutions
- Proven experience in agricultural sales, precision agriculture, crop protection equipment, application technology or related industries
- Customer Knowledge: Ability to talk with customers, understand their production systems, identify how Crop Care solutions can help improve their results and translate product capabilities into operational and business value
- Sales Execution: Experience managing sales opportunities, customer relationships and pipeline activities from identification through closing
- Dealer Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with dealers, customers and cross-functional teams to drive business results
- Communication Skills: Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical and commercial information to different audiences
- Action-Oriented: Bias towards action, with the ability to roll up sleeves and start doing it to get the ball rolling
- Analytical Skills: Experience using CRM systems and sales pipeline management tools to support forecasting and execution
- Flexibility: Willingness to travel and spend time in the field as needed to support dealers and customers

**What Makes You Stand Out:**

- Experience with self-propelled and trailed sprayers, crop care equipment or application technologies
- Knowledge of precision agriculture technologies and their integration into Crop Care solutions
- Established network within the agricultural industry and dealer channel
- Demonstrated ability to execute complex sales opportunities and multi-stakeholder customer engagements
- Experience building effective relationships with customers, dealers and internal partners
- Demonstrated experience working broadly across John Deere, collaborating with multiple teams, functions or business units to drive impact
- Track record of exceeding sales objectives and driving market share growth

**Education:**

description:
Du möchtest junge Menschen und Familien auf ihrem Weg begleiten, Ressourcen stärken und gemeinsam neue Perspektiven entwickeln? Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen!
Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte Sozialpädagoginnen (m/w/d) oder Fachkräfte mit vergleichbarer akademischer Qualifikation für unsere Angebote in Voll- oder Teilzeit. Als Teil unseres Teams unterstützt du gemeinsam mit uns Kinder, Jugendliche, junge Erwachsene und Familien dabei, ihre eigenen Stärken zu entdecken, Herausforderungen zu bewältigen und neue Handlungsmöglichkeiten zu entwickeln. Die Stelle ist zunächst gemäß § 14 Abs. 2 TzBfG befristet. Eine Übernahme in ein unbefristetes Beschäftigungsverhältnis wird angestrebt. Die Vergütung erfolgt nach den AVR der Diakonie Bayern, Entgeltgruppe E 10. Über uns Die Flexible Jugendhilfe Fürstenfeldbruck-Dachau arbeitet eng mit den Landratsämtern Fürstenfeldbruck und Dachau zusammen und bietet vielfältige ambulante Hilfen zur Erziehung an. Dabei steht für uns der Mensch mit seiner individuellen Lebensgeschichte im Mittelpunkt. Wir betrachten junge Menschen und ihre Familien stets in ihrem sozialen und familiären Umfeld. Die bisherigen Bewältigungs- und Anpassungsleistungen unserer Klientinnen verstehen wir nicht als Defizite, sondern als individuelle Ressourcen und Ausgangspunkt für Veränderung.
Gemeinsam mit den Familien und jungen Menschen entwickeln wir neue Perspektiven und erweitern Handlungsspielräume. Unser Ziel ist es, Selbstwirksamkeit, Eigenständigkeit und soziale Teilhabe zu stärken und nachhaltige Veränderungen zu ermöglichen.
Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt: Flexible Betreute Wohnformen
Darüber hinaus begleiten wir junge Menschen ab dem vollendeten 16. Lebensjahr im Rahmen unserer Flexiblen Betreuten Wohnformen auf ihrem Weg in ein selbstständiges und eigenverantwortliches Leben.
Hier geht es darum, junge Menschen individuell zu unterstützen, ihnen Sicherheit und Orientierung zu geben und sie Schritt für Schritt in ihrer Verselbstständigung zu fördern.
Was dich bei uns erwartet
Dich erwartet ein abwechslungsreiches und vielseitiges Arbeitsfeld, in dem du eigenverantwortlich arbeiten und gleichzeitig auf ein engagiertes Team zählen kannst.
Du hast die Möglichkeit, deine fachlichen Kompetenzen und persönlichen Stärken einzubringen und gemeinsam mit den jungen Menschen und Familien an individuellen Lösungen zu arbeiten.
Du passt zu uns, wenn du …
• Freude an der Arbeit mit Kindern, Jugendlichen, jungen Erwachsenen und Familien hast,
• eine wertschätzende und ressourcenorientierte Haltung mitbringst,
• auch in herausfordernden Situationen den Überblick behältst,
• gerne eigenverantwortlich und gleichzeitig im Team arbeitest,
• Veränderungsprozesse begleiten und mitgestalten möchtest,
• dich für die Lebenswelten und individuellen Geschichten junger Menschen interessierst und
• Lust hast, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln und neue Ideen einzubringen.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich persönlich kennenzulernen!

Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.

. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. Other benefits depending on the location

title: HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d) (Compliance-Manager/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d).

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann auch an folgenden Standorten lokalisiert sein:

- Amadora, Portugal- Bratislava, Slowakei- Budapest, Ungarn- Madrid, Spanien- Prag, Tschechische Republik- Warschau, Polen

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie sind zuständig für die Konzeption, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des HR-internen Kontrollsystems.- Sie koordinieren und übernehmen Aktivitäten im Bereich Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) für HR-relevante Prozesse.- Sie entwickeln, dokumentieren und optimieren Kontrolldesigns zur Sicherstellung regulatorischer und interner Compliance-Anforderungen.- Sie überwachen die Wirksamkeit etablierter Kontrollen, analysieren Kontrollschwächen und treiben geeignete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen nach.- Sie wirken bei der Durchführung von Control-Monitoring-Aktivitäten mit und bereiten Nachweise für interne und externe Audits auf.- Sie sind zuständig für Überwachung von Cybersecurity Controls innerhalb der HR-Funktion und arbeiten eng mit Cybersecurity-, IT- und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen.- Sie beraten Prozessverantwortliche hinsichtlich Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Anforderungen und fördern die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Kontrollen.- Sie erstellen Management-Reports, Dashboards und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Führungskräfte und relevante Governance-Gremien.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Master-Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht, Compliance, Risikomanagement oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Compliance, Internal Controls, Audit, Risk Management oder Governance.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung mit internen Kontrollsystemen (ICS), ICFR-/SOX-nahen Anforderungen oder Audit-Prozessen.- Sie haben gute Kenntnisse von HR-Prozessen sowie deren Risiko- und Kontrollanforderungen sind von Vorteil.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.- Sie haben keinen Studienabschluss? Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Berufsausbildung in Verbindung mit einer qualifizierten Weiterbildung und darauf bezogene umfangreiche fachspezifische Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über fließende Englischkenntnisse, gute Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil- Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.- Sie können komplexe Compliance- und Kontrollanforderungen verständlich vermitteln.- Sie arbeiten eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.- Sie überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder ohne direkte Weisungskompetenz zu beeinflussen.- Sie bringen eine hohe Integrität sowie ein ausgeprägtes Risiko- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit.- Sie treiben Veränderungen aktiv voran und fördern eine nachhaltige Compliance- und Kontrollkultur.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist Klaus Kouril.

Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level
Icelandic [Optional] Intermediate
Spanish [Optional] Intermediate

Compensation:
Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Work Hours:
Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.
Contact:  For more information, please contact us at CAEHF@proton.me

Job Title: Sheet Metal Worker Reports to: Structures Crew Leader Location: Atlantic Aviation Group, Shannon Airport, Shannon, Co Clare Apply: Email your up-to-date CV together with any supporting qualifications to careers@atlanticaviation.ie Atlantic Aviation Group With over 55 years of experience, Shannon based Atlantic Aviation Group (AAG) is one of Europe's leading independent aviation solution providers. The company has a strong reputation of providing customers with a complete range of solutions including; aircraft maintenance modifications, technical, engineering and design services, logistics and material solutions and international training and consultancy. This reputation is built on a proud history and tradition of superior craftsmanship, technical expertise and continuous training, which is supported by our flexible, open and partnership-based customer relationships. The company provides a range of aviation solutions including; Part 145 Aircraft Maintenance, CAMO & Technical Services, Part 21 Design Services and the EASA Part 147 Atlantic Aviation Institute which provides aviation training to airlines, MRO’s and companies around the world. Aircraft Sheet Metal Worker required to join the Structures Team in AAG. In this role you will be required to join the existing team in a busy Production environment. You will be expected to perform all types of repairs, assessments and modifications to Aircraft Structures and components. General Responsibility Accountable for the Safe, On-Time delivery of all Structural repairs. Repair, rework, install and fabricate the complex aircraft structural assemblies, both internal and external. Remove and disassemble defective parts of the aircraft Adhere to company procedures, maintaining Safety and Quality standards at all times, reporting any discrepancies to respective Manager/Team Leader, generating SMS reports as necessary Carry out all repairs and tasks using the relevant approved Repair Manuals, Drawings/Technical Instructions as provided by the OEM Maintain a safe, organized and clean work environment according to in house 5S principles, including proper usage of tooling Ensures relevant repair documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner Working collaboratively with your Crew Leader, inspector and the Production team. Integration of our values and pillars as a constant way of operating including compliance with the organisational policies and procedures detailed in the Atlantic Aviation Group MOE and Supporting manuals. Candidate Requirements Candidates must have a minimum of 4 years’ experience in Aircraft Structures repair/modification. Heavy maintenance experience is an advantage but not essential. Must be proficient in the use of Aircraft manuals, Boeing Engine Atlantic Aviation Group is an equal opportunities employer. The people of Atlantic Aviation Group are the foundation of its success, and we believe that employing a diverse workforce is key to this success.

Job Title: Sheet Metal Worker Reports to: Structures Crew Leader Location: Atlantic Aviation Group, Shannon Airport, Shannon, Co Clare Apply: Email your up-to-date CV together with any supporting qualifications to careers@atlanticaviation.ie Atlantic Aviation Group With over 55 years of experience, Shannon based Atlantic Aviation Group (AAG) is one of Europe's leading independent aviation solution providers. The company has a strong reputation of providing customers with a complete range of solutions including; aircraft maintenance modifications, technical, engineering and design services, logistics and material solutions and international training and consultancy. This reputation is built on a proud history and tradition of superior craftsmanship, technical expertise and continuous training, which is supported by our flexible, open and partnership-based customer relationships. The company provides a range of aviation solutions including; Part 145 Aircraft Maintenance, CAMO & Technical Services, Part 21 Design Services and the EASA Part 147 Atlantic Aviation Institute which provides aviation training to airlines, MRO’s and companies around the world. Aircraft Sheet Metal Worker required to join the Structures Team in AAG. In this role you will be required to join the existing team in a busy Production environment. You will be expected to perform all types of repairs, assessments and modifications to Aircraft Structures and components. General Responsibility Accountable for the Safe, On-Time delivery of all Structural repairs. Repair, rework, install and fabricate the complex aircraft structural assemblies, both internal and external. Remove and disassemble defective parts of the aircraft Adhere to company procedures, maintaining Safety and Quality standards at all times, reporting any discrepancies to respective Manager/Team Leader, generating SMS reports as necessary Carry out all repairs and tasks using the relevant approved Repair Manuals, Drawings/Technical Instructions as provided by the OEM Maintain a safe, organized and clean work environment according to in house 5S principles, including proper usage of tooling Ensures relevant repair documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner Working collaboratively with your Crew Leader, inspector and the Production team. Integration of our values and pillars as a constant way of operating including compliance with the organisational policies and procedures detailed in the Atlantic Aviation Group MOE and Supporting manuals. Candidate Requirements Candidates must have a minimum of 4 years’ experience in Aircraft Structures repair/modification. Heavy maintenance experience is an advantage but not essential. Must be proficient in the use of Aircraft manuals, Boeing Engine Atlantic Aviation Group is an equal opportunities employer. The people of Atlantic Aviation Group are the foundation of its success, and we believe that employing a diverse workforce is key to this success.

description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. The successful candidate will be a customer-focused facilities professional with strong leadership skills, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to manage operational performance in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Operational Management Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft facilities services across the contract. Lead, motivate, and develop the on-site service delivery team. Oversee planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and lifecycle replacement programmes. Manage reactive maintenance requests and ensure contractual service levels are achieved. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Health, Safety & Compliance Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation and company policies. Lead safety initiatives including toolbox talks, safety walks, and near-miss reporting. Monitor contractor compliance and site safety performance. Promote a strong culture of safety and continuous improvement across all service lines. Financial & Contract Management Monitor lifecycle expenditure and ensure spending remains within agreed budgets. Manage materials ordering and cost control processes. Support small works estimation and project delivery. Understand and interpret contractual requirements to ensure compliance and value delivery. Administration & Reporting Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. About You Essential Experience & Skills Previous Facilities Management experience in a management or supervisory capacity. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience working in a client-facing environment.

title: Artic & Rigid Tipper Driver
description:

Job Title: Artic & Rigid Tipper Driver Employer: Royalbridge Limited Location: Summerhill, Co. Meath, with travel to project sites as required Salary: €37,544 per annum Hours: 40 hours per week Job Description Royalbridge Limited is seeking an experienced HGV Driver to operate articulated and rigid tipper vehicles. The successful candidate will be responsible for transporting construction and excavation materials safely and efficiently between project sites, loading areas and other designated locations. Main Responsibilities • Operate articulated and rigid HGV tipper vehicles safely and efficiently. • Transport materials including soil, stone and aggregates between sites and designated locations. • Carry out daily vehicle safety checks, including tyres, brakes, lights and fluid levels. • Ensure loads are safely distributed and secured before travelling. • Follow assigned routes, delivery schedules and site instructions. • Maintain accurate tachograph, driving-time, mileage and working-time records. • Comply with road safety, drivers' hours, tachograph and company procedures. • Report any vehicle defects, mechanical faults or safety concerns promptly. • Operate tipping equipment safely when loading and unloading materials. • Keep the vehicle clean, safe and in good working condition. Requirements • Valid Category CE driving licence, or equivalent licence category recognised by the Road Safety Authority under a mutual recognition agreement. • Previous professional HGV driving experience, preferably operating articulated and/or rigid tipper vehicles. • Good knowledge of road safety, drivers' hours and tachograph requirements. • Clean driving record. • Ability to carry out routine vehicle checks and maintain accurate driving records. • Driver CPC and Digital Tachograph Card, or ability to obtain/complete the relevant requirements before commencing professional driving in Ireland. • Safe Pass, or ability to obtain it before commencing work on construction sites. • Where applicable, employment is subject to the successful grant of the relevant Irish Employment Permit and immigration permission.

title: Aviation Trainer
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Job title Aviation Trainer Reports to: Head of 147 Training Contract Type: 2 Year Fixed Term Location: Atlantic Aviation Group, Shannon Airport, Shannon, Co Clare Duties and responsibilities are, but not limited to the following: Develop and deliver Aviation Training programs. Be capable and competent delivering EASA Part 66 Theoretical and Workshop Practical Training modules, and other aviation training in line with customer needs (both in PART 145 or other). Develop, prepare and review course material and rooms/workshops for Aviation Training programs. This could include EASA Part 66 modules/ Continuation Training/ Practical Training and other aviation training in line with customer needs. Carry out practical training and assessments, in line with Part 147 requirements. Carry out assessments / examinations in line with Part 147 requirements. Professionally conduct training, ensuring that standards and guidelines are clear to students. Create an environment conducive to effective learning whilst ensuring the safety of all students. Participate in / contribute to the planning of training/examination schedules and in the co-ordination of same with Customers, Authorities etc. Propose solutions/ideas to bottlenecks/issues within the training schedule. Support the maintenance of examination data-bases, keeping them current and secure in line with AAG and International Standards. Participate in reviewing the effectiveness of training and in implementing appropriate corrective, preventative or improvement activities required or agreed with the Aviation Training Team Leader / Head of 147 Training. Support the up-dating of our MTOE and other policies, procedures and directives and ensure courses are delivered in accordance with same. Lead projects or programs as assigned by the Aviation Training Team Leader or Head of Aviation Services. Deliver training which will involve working away from base and outside of Ireland for long- and short-term durations. Support other Aviation Services Teams. Deputise for the Aviation Training Team Leader if applicable Essential skills and qualifications Has completed a recognised Traineeship / Apprenticeship in Aircraft Maintenance (Mechanical or Avionics) or Structures and Composites training or completed a Traineeship or Apprenticeship in a technical trade. Must be prepared to pass the relevant EASA Part 66 Modules if you have not passed them already. Experience as a teacher, instructor or trainer, with experience in an EASA Part 147 environment a distinct advantage. Have a good knowledge of EASA Parts 145, 147 and 66. Have excellent verbal and written communication skills. Be a good team player with demonstrated excellent interpersonal, time management (of assigned tasks and projects) and organisational skill

title: Night Audit (Night-Auditor)
description:
Night Audit

Company Description

Our heart beats turquoise.

Working at Motel One is like coming home to friends, where you can be your true self and where appreciation and support matter. We meet on an equal footing and see ourselves as one team: from our management to our trainees.

We create a home away from home for our guests with our shared passion for modern design and high-quality service. Our more than 80 hotels in 12 countries impress with exclusive design, high service standards and first-class inner-city locations at an attractive price.

As the founder and pioneer of the budget design concept, we are successfully expanding in the metropolises of Europe and beyond. Become part of our team and develop Motel One with us.

Job Description

Looking after our guests in a professional manner at the front desk is extremely important at all times – from a warm welcome at check-in until their departure, your job will be to assist our early risers and night owls. Your duties will also include the following:

- Welcoming guests, checking in and out.
- Preparing daily closing balances
- Cash transactions and cashing up
- Processing booking requests
- Preparing and serving Drinks.
- Preparing for breakfast
- General light cleaning of the lobby and public areas.

Qualifications

Whether you are a hotel professional or changing careers – you will fit in here! Because personality and hosting skills are our priority. You will also:

- Have an excellent sense of quality and service, as well as hosting skills and a passion for the hotel industry
- Be open, communicative and confident and have a solid command of English
- Be a team player and willing to provide assistance across departments – we achieve our results together
- Applicants must be able to speak, read, and understand English to effectively communicate in the role.

Job Title: Sheet Metal Worker Reports to: Structures Crew Leader Location: Atlantic Aviation Group, Shannon Airport, Shannon, Co Clare Apply: Email your up-to-date CV together with any supporting qualifications to careers@atlanticaviation.ie Atlantic Aviation Group With over 55 years of experience, Shannon based Atlantic Aviation Group (AAG) is one of Europe's leading independent aviation solution providers. description: Grafton Office* per Coop, tra i principali operatori della distribuzione italiana, è alla ricerca di giovani neolaureati interessati a intraprendere un percorso di carriera manageriale all'interno delle Cooperative di consumatori. Il contratto prevede: Inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato.
