title: Site Manager – Electrical Commissioning | Data Centers
description:
Are you an experienced electrical commissioning professional ready to take the lead on site? This is an opportunity to join a large-scale data center project where you will take ownership of the commissioning activities, lead a technical team, and act as a key interface between the project and the customer.

About the role

As Site Manager, you will be responsible for leading and coordinating the electrical commissioning activities on site. You will manage a team of Field Service Representatives and commissioning engineers, ensuring that the project progresses according to schedule while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and technical execution.

This is a role for someone who combines a strong electrical and commissioning background with leadership, project coordination, and stakeholder management.

Work tasks

    Lead and coordinate the commissioning team on site
    Plan and coordinate electrical installation and commissioning activities
    Manage schedules, resources, priorities, and project progress
    Lead daily coordination meetings and follow up on ongoing activities
    Act as the primary point of contact for the customer on site
    Coordinate contractors, suppliers, and other project stakeholders
    Ensure commissioning activities are performed according to safety and quality requirements
    Identify and manage project risks and technical issues
    Monitor progress and provide regular status reports
    Support and oversee commissioning activities throughout the L2–L5 commissioning process

We are looking for

    A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or equivalent
    Several years of experience within electrical commissioning of LV and MV systems
    Previous experience from data center projects
    Experience leading commissioning teams or technical teams on site
    Strong understanding of the L2–L5 commissioning process
    Experience with Schneider Electric LV and UPS systems
    Ability to read and understand electrical drawings, schematics, and Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)
    Experience coordinating contractors, suppliers, and technical stakeholders
    Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills
    Professional fluency in English
    Current residence in Sweden

To succeed in the role

You are a confident technical leader who enjoys taking ownership and creating structure in complex projects. You are comfortable making decisions, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and keeping both technical execution and project progress on track.

You combine a hands-on understanding of electrical commissioning with the ability to lead people, communicate with customers, and maintain a clear overview of the entire commissioning process.



Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Our Culture & Commitment to You

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. You’ll find us at our Innovation Center in Mölnlycke, just 10 minutes from Gothenburg with excellent commuting options. Here, every employee is part of a dynamic and innovative environment where everyone understands how their work contributes to the success of our company.

title: R&D Function Expert
description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of advanced manufacturing technology, innovation and knowledge development? We’re now looking for an R&D Function Expert to join our Production Technology & Geometrical Measuring team – an exciting opportunity to shape the future of machining technologies and manufacturing methods while collaborating with experts across a global organization.

Join our R&D organization, dedicated to developing the knowledge and technologies necessary for our future products and solutions. Here, you get to:

    Identify future technologies and knowledge areas based on strategic needs and technology push, and help shape the roadmap for Machining Development.
    Collaborate with passionate colleagues, partners and researchers in an international setting.
    Grow your expertise while helping shape the future of manufacturing and machining technology.

About the job

You’re our expert in Manufacturing Methods and Processes, involving both strategic and operational aspects by developing our knowledge and technology strategy for the field, while turning plans and strategies into action. You provide technical leadership, influencing colleagues, stakeholders and decision-makers across the organization on complex technology choices, priorities and ways of working with broad business impact. A key part of your role is Machining Development, contributing to the development of new manufacturing methods and technologies.

Job responsibilities

    Take technical leadership for both the content and direction of the machining area, setting priorities, and driving effective ways of working.
    Identify future machining technologies and knowledge needs.
    Set the roadmap, initiate projects, and drive technology development together with your core team and stakeholders.
    Translate new knowledge and technologies into future products and efficient production methods.
    Build valuable internal and external collaborations through research and development activities.
    Share expertise, coach colleagues and support competence development within the organization.

Location

Your profile

You have a relevant academic background in mechanical engineering, engineering or another technical field, or equivalent knowledge gained through experience. A solid foundation in machining, manufacturing technology or a closely related area enables you to apply both theoretical and practical expertise to complex technical challenges.

Your background includes

    Knowledge of CNC technology and controller capabilities, CAD, simulation of tool paths, post-processor development or programming.
    Experience developing methods, technologies or technical solutions.

A positive and collaborative mindset helps you succeed in this position. You build trust through strong communication, enjoy working with others and take ownership of your area of expertise. Curiosity, a strategic perspective and a willingness to both learn and share knowledge make a real difference in this role.

Our culture

Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. title: Frukost/lunch värd/värdinna - Breakfast/lunch host/hostess
description:
På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.

I hjärtat av Camp Ripan finner du vår fantastiska restaurang där vi erbjuder frukost, lunch och middag samt möjlighet till större arrangemang. Inspirationen är hämtad ur stadens tre kulturer – den svenska, den samiska och den tornedalsfinska och det är detta som genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Nu söker vi dig som förutom ett roligt och utmanande arbete är redo för storslagen fjällvärld, magiskt norrsken och fantastiska fritidsaktiviteter.

Som frukostvärd/frukostvärdinna är du en viktig del av våra gästers morgon och ser till att de får en riktigt bra start på dagen. Du börjar tidigt med att förbereda och ställa i ordning frukosten inför öppning, fylla på buffén och se till att restaurangen är ren, fräsch och välkomnande. Under frukosten välkomnar du våra gäster, håller buffén välfylld, dukar av och finns till hands för frågor och önskemål.

Vi söker dig som är morgonpigg och inte har några problem med att starta dagen redan klockan 04.00, alltid med ett leende. Du har ansvarskänsla, brinner för service och tycker om att skapa en trivsam och välkomnande atmosfär. Som person är du flexibel, effektiv och har en god kommunikation med dina kollegor. Du trivs i ett högt tempo, är lösningsorienterad och ser vad som behöver göras utan att alltid behöva bli tillsagd.

Arbetet innebär ett nära samarbete med köket och övriga avdelningar, och under perioder med högt tempo hjälps vi åt där det behövs. Vi värdesätter därför prestigelöshet, laganda och viljan att bidra till en riktigt bra gästupplevelse.

Det är ett krav att du har goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska. Övriga språkkunskaper är meriterande, liksom tidigare erfarenhet inom restaurang, hotell eller service.

Tjänsten är en särskild visstidsanställning med start i mitten på december och slut i slutet på februari med möjlighet till förlängning.

Personalboende finns att tillgå. Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person för tjänsten.



At Camp Ripan, you will have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by the nature and culture that make our region so special. We value our employees and offer a workplace where you can grow and develop. You will become a part of a close-knit team where collaboration, service and mutual respect are fundamental.

At the heart of Camp Ripan you find our fantastic restaurant, where we offer breakfast, lunch and dinner, as well as larger events and gatherings. Our inspiration comes from the city’s three cultures – Swedish, Sámi and Tornedalian-Finnish – and these influences are reflected throughout our entire operation. We are now looking for someone who is ready to combine an exciting and challenging job with the spectacular mountain landscape, magical Northern Lights and fantastic outdoor activities.

As a breakfast host, you play an important role in our guests’ mornings and make sure they get a great start to their day. You start early by preparing and setting up the breakfast before opening, keeping the buffet stocked and making sure the restaurant is clean, fresh and welcoming. During breakfast, you welcome our guests, keep the buffet well stocked, clear tables and are available to assist with any questions or requests.

We are looking for someone who is an early riser and has no problem starting the day as early as 4:00 AM, always with a smile. You are responsible, passionate about service and enjoy creating a welcoming and pleasant atmosphere. You are flexible, efficient and communicate well with your colleagues. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, are solution-oriented and can see what needs to be done without always having to be asked.

The role involves close collaboration with the kitchen and other departments, and during busy periods, we support each other wherever needed. We therefore value a humble attitude, team spirit and a genuine desire to contribute to an excellent guest experience.

Good knowledge of Swedish and/or English is required. Additional language skills are an advantage, as is previous experience in the restaurant, hotel or service industry.

The position is a fixed-term temporary employment starting in mid-December and ending at the end of February, with the possibility of an extension.

Staff accommodation is available. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and employment will be offered once we have found the right person for the position.

title: Products & Solutions Development Manager
description:
Lead the Future of Energy – Process Engineering Manager Wanted

The world is in transition towards balanced energy, you can play an important part in crafting this future.

The D&S (Development & Standards) department is responsible for product development and maintenance of the auxiliary systems for the medium sized gas turbines. Thanks to our strong performance and positive momentum, we are growing and expanding our organization, bringing in additional managers to support our continued success.

We are looking for a manager for the process engineering group 1 responsible for the Air Intake, Acoustic enclosures, CFD, Gas/Fire Detection & Fire extinguishing systems.

A Snapshot of Your Day

In a typical day you will start the morning with an alignment meeting with your manager, Technical Area Managers and Lead Engineers to discuss about the outcome of yesterday’s work and the challenges of today. After this you will attend a gate or review team meeting related to product development of the new system design or work with planning of resources for upcoming projects and tasks

Just before lunch you attend a discussion on the strategy around next generation engineering system tools. Afterwards, you reflect together with your three closest manager colleagues on how you can collaborate to introduce the tools.

After a good lunch, you have a meeting with your team to follow up the progress and discuss group strategy. Next on schedule in your calendar is to attend a project pipeline meeting for a follow-up of the product development portfolio.

Just before you plan to end your job day, you see an email in your inbox, your application for specialist nomination for one of your employees has been approved. Tomorrow you will have good news to give her, but now it is time to head home.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Develop your team and your processes, create a world class working place and secure a successful future.

You will define and drive business strategies in alignment with your department's objectives and vision.

Contribute to the setup of the future process engineering department.

Support the system development of our engineering tools landscape ensuring we strive for our PLM vision.

Attendance in product-related gate and design reviews, ensuring high standards and compliance for your technical areas.

Conduct resource planning and allocation, making sure that the right competences are available and accessible for upcoming projects.

 

What You Bring

Strong leadership skills with significant experience in leading people and teams.

A positive attitude and a proactive, can-do mindset, combined with the ability to make decisions and drive things forward.

A strategic business approach and a good understanding of gas turbine technology and our products.

Excellent communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across various functions and teams.

Strong drive and organizational skills, with the ability to see the complete picture.

Fluency in English, with a proven track record to act in an international environment. Swedish is beneficial.

 

About the Team

In this role, you will report to the Head of Process Engineering (PE). And be part of the D&S PE management team who enjoy working together and having fun at work.

Your department will consist of approx. 9 employees (plus temporary workers and colleagues in India

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

title: Hotell- och konferenschef
description:
Wendelsbergs folkhögskola söker en hotell- och konferenschef som vill kombinera affärsmässighet med samhällsnytta. Tillträde under hösten 2026.

Hotell- och konferenschefen har ansvar för hotell, vandrarhem och konferensverksamhet. Det innefattar ledning av en personalgrupp på ca 10 personer, planering av verksamheten, försäljning, prissättning, marknadsföring och utveckling av både boende- och konferensverksamheten. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med kökschef och även andra verksamheter på skolan.

Vi söker dig som har en relevant utbildning och flera års erfarenhet av att driva och utveckla småskalig hotellverksamhet. Du har en naturlig känsla för värdskap och service och gillar kundkontakter. Du behöver känna en drivkraft i att utveckla verksamhet i en helnykter miljö och får gärna ha erfarenhet från idéburna organisationer. Vi ser gärna också att du har erfarenhet och intresse av digital marknadsföring. Ditt ledarskap präglas av tydlighet och god förmåga att fatta beslut kombinerat med en förmåga att lyssna. Administrativa uppgifter ingår i rollen, så ordning och reda är viktigt. Du kommer också att vara operativ i verksamheten och vid olika arrangemang hjälps vi alla åt. Schemalagt kvälls- och helgjobb ingår i tjänsten.

Wendelsberg – vi utbildar världsförbättrare och livsnjutare

Wendelsbergs folkhögskola är en av Movendi Sveriges (tidigare IOGT-NTO:s) två folkhögskolor och har erbjudit utbildningar i helnykter miljö sedan 1908. Wendelsberg är i första hand en skola men här finns dessutom flera andra viktiga verksamheter. Vi driver vandrarhem, hotell och viss restaurangverksamhet. Vandrarhemmet är anslutet till STF. Vi ger offentliga föreställningar i vår teater och erbjuder konferensmöjligheter i en unik miljö.

Wendelsberg har ett drygt 40-tal engagerade anställda och ett par hundra heltidsstuderande varav hälften bor på vårt internat. Hotellet/vandrarhemmet är helårsöppet med 28 rum. På sommaren ställer vi om internatboendet till vandrarhem och då tillkommer ytterligare ett 50-tal rum. Wendelsberg ligger i Mölnlycke – knappa 20 minuter från Göteborgs centrum.

Verksamheterna här är många och skiftande. På facebook, instagram, wendelsberg.se, wendelsberg.com och wendelsbergstetater.com kan du läsa mer och bättre förstå vad vi sysslar med.

Skolan har nära kontakt med huvudmannen vars värderingar genomsyrar verksamheten på Wendelsberg. Du kan läsa mer om huvudmannens verksamhet och framtida utveckling på www.iogt.se.

title: Bioprocess Laboratory Engineer - 18819
description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. We are looking for a Laboratory Engineer / Bioprocess Laboratory Engineer

title: Bartender - Vintersäsong
description:
På Camp Ripan får du möjlighet att arbeta i en unik miljö, omgiven av natur och kultur som är speciell för vår region. Vi värderar våra medarbetare högt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du kan växa och utvecklas. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat team där samarbete, service och respekt för varandra är grundläggande.

I hjärtat av Camp Ripan finner du vår fantastiska restaurang där vi erbjuder frukost, lunch och middag samt möjlighet till större arrangemang. Inspirationen är hämtad ur stadens tre kulturer – den svenska, den samiska och den tornedalsfinska och det är detta som genomsyrar hela verksamheten. Nu söker vi dig som förutom ett roligt och utmanande arbete är redo för storslagen fjällvärld, sprakande norrsken och fantastiska fritidsaktiviteter.

Som bartender hos oss är du en viktig del av gästens helhetsupplevelse. Du ansvarar för att välkomna gäster, blanda och servera cocktails och andra drycker, ta beställningar, hantera kassa samt ge personlig service och rekommendationer. Du ser till att baren är välfylld, välkomnande och håller hög standard. Arbetet innebär även nära samarbete med restaurangen, där du vid behov hjälper till med servering och andra förekommande arbetsuppgifter.

Du som söker är prestigelös och flexibel, förstår vikten av att vara en lagspelare för att nå uppsatta mål. En vilja att lära kombinerat med en nyfikenhet och intresse för mat och dryck, allt för att gästen ska få med sig en känsla av att de fått något alldeles extra efter en vistelse hos oss.

Goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska är ett krav, liksom erfarenhet av bartending. Övriga språkkunskaper är meriterande och även tidigare erfarenhet av servering och kassahantering. Här kan tempot emellanåt vara högt och du behöver vara beredd att kunna rycka in där det behövs.

Möjlighet till personalboende finns. Intervjuer sker löpande och anställning sker när vi hittat rätt person för tjänsten.



At Camp Ripan, you will have the opportunity to work in a unique environment, surrounded by the nature and culture that make our region so special. We value our employees and offer a workplace where you can grow and develop. You will become a part of a close-knit team where collaboration, service and mutual respect are fundamental.

At the heart of Camp Ripan you find our fantastic restaurant, where we offer breakfast, lunch and dinner, as well as larger events and gatherings. Our inspiration comes from the city’s three cultures – Swedish, Sámi and Tornedalian-Finnish – and these influences are reflected throughout our entire operation. We are now looking for someone who is ready to combine an exciting and challenging job with the spectacular mountain landscape, dancing Northern Lights and fantastic outdoor activities.

As a bartender with us, you will play an important role in creating an exceptional guest experience. Your responsibilities include welcoming guests, preparing and serving cocktails and other beverages, taking orders, handling payments, and providing personal service and recommendations. You will make sure the bar is well-stocked, welcoming and maintained to a high standard. The role also involves close collaboration with the restaurant, where you may be asked to assist with serving and other duties when needed.

We are looking for someone who is humble, flexible and understands the importance of being a team player in achieving our goals. A willingness to learn, combined with curiosity and an interest in food and beverages, is essential to creating an experience where our guests leave feeling that they have received something truly special during their stay.

Good knowledge of Swedish and/or English is required, as well as previous bartending experience. Additional language skills are an advantage, as is previous experience in serving and cash handling. The pace can be high at times, and you need to be willing to step in and help wherever needed.

Staff accommodation is available. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and employment will be offered once we have found the right person for the position.

title: First Officer to M/S Eckerö Link
description:
Jobs on the Horizon - Welcome to Eckerö Link!

Eckerö Group has recently expanded its fleet with a new vessel, M/S Eckerö Link (formerly Nautica). The vessel is scheduled to enter service in September/October 2026.

We are currently seeking a First Officer to join us on M/S Eckerö Link. This is a permanent position starting immediately or as agreed.

M/S Eckerö Link sails under the Swedish flag and operates daily between Långnäs (Åland) and Naantali (Finland). The work rotation follows a 2:3 schedule.

The official working and safety language onboard is English, while skills in Finnish and Swedish are considered an advantage.

About the Role

The First Officer is responsible for safe navigation and watchkeeping, as well as supporting the safe and efficient operation of the vessel. Duties include monitoring safety and bridge equipment, assisting with deck and cargo operations, and following established safety procedures.

Who Are You?

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

    Relevant professional experience and qualifications
    Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills
    A positive attitude and commitment to high safety and environmental standards

Requirements:

    A valid Deck Officer Certificate (STCW II/1) - Higher certifications are considered an advantage.

What We Offer

As a member of the Eckerö Link team, you will enjoy:

    Interesting and versatile duties in a dynamic and evolving company. We support learning, development, and career progression.
    A friendly, fair, and committed work community—both ashore in Mariehamn and onboard.
    Comprehensive occupational health care, as well as accident insurance covering both work and leisure time.

Interested?

Please submit your application and CV by 17 September 2026

For security reasons, we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the deadline.

Please note that drug testing is part of our recruitment process for all new employees.

For more information, please contact:

Gabriella Andersson, HR Specialist

gabriella.andersson@rederiabeckero.ax

Welcome aboard!

About Eckerö Group

Our ambition is to be the natural choice for both travel and transport across our destinations.

We aim to offer a pleasant, smart, and responsible way to travel and move goods — always going the extra mile to create a positive experience for our customers and passengers. Meeting one of us should feel like meeting a friend — we provide simple, reliable, and thoughtful solutions.

The Eckerö Group comprises three companies: Eckerö Line, Eckerö Linjen and Eckerö Link. Together, we operate a wide range of services, including passenger and vehicle ferry connections across the Sea of Åland, combined passenger and freight services on the Gulf of Finland, and dedicated freight operations between Långnäs and Naantali. We employ around 850 professionals.

title: SAFETY & COMPLIANCE ENGINEER
description:
Company description:

Scandinavian Airlines System SAS

Job description:  We are looking for a Compliance and Safety Engineer  

Are you excited about development, administration and maintenance of effective safety and compliance management? If so, the role as Compliance & Safety Engineer for SAS Link might be the perfect fit for you! 







In this role, you will be responsible for the processes as required by CAMO.A.305 and directly connected to SAS core value of keeping a safe operation. You will report directly to the SAS Link NPCA and Technical Director.







SAS Link operates a fleet of 16 E195-E1, mainly operating in the Scandinavian intra-domestic market and is planned to expand to a fleet of 45 E195-E2 over the next 4 years.

     Challenges you will work on:  


    Facilitate and co-ordinate hazard identification, risk assessment and management.
    Maintain the CAMO Hazard register.
    Monitor the implementation of actions taken to mitigate risks, as listed in the safety action plan.
    Coordinate Safety Action Group meetings including material and actions derived from them.
    Ensure that training is available, and that it meets acceptable standards.
    Review all SMS and HF feedback gleaned from recurrent training, and incorporate as appropriate into the recurrent training syllabus and training documentation.
    Provide advice on safety matters.
    Ensure the initiation, follow-up and due dates of internal occurrence investigations, hazard mitigations and compliance findings.2
    Provide oversight of the functioning of the occurrence reporting system.
    Analyze all occurrences collected in order to identify the safety hazards associated with identified occurrences or groups of occurrences.
    Maintain and coordinate training requirements, results and expiries for all CAMO personnel.
    Ensure at least annually that manuals remain relevant in accordance with regulatory requirements and AOC operations.
    Coordinate with external and internal auditors for audit preparations

     The Team  

You will be part of a high-performing and diverse team composed of talented professionals from various backgrounds. Our team values collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to excellence. We support each other and thrive on creating a positive and inclusive work environment where everyone can succeed.

     To be successful we believe you have  


    Practical experience in the application of aviation maintenance standards and safe operating practices.
    Knowledge of regulations applicable to the Operator: Part M / Part CAMO / Part 145, Part.CAT.IDE.A / Part 26
    Knowledge of the AOC Compliance Monitoring and Safety systems.
    3 years relevant work experience in the subject or similar role.
    An aeronautical degree or aircraft maintenance technician qualification (EASA Part 66 Licence)
    Knowledge of maintenance methods.
    Knowledge of applicable regulations and mandatory requirements.
    Have a fundamental understanding of the English language Competence within MS Office package, mainly Word, Excel and Outlook
    Knowledge of E1 and or E2 is a plus
    AMOS Basic Knowledge is a plus







As a person, we believe you are proactive with strong planning, priority and organizational skills, have the ability to collect, handle and structure a large amount of information for data-driven decision making, and be able to keep sharp judgement skills in a fast changing and dynamic environment. We believe you have a strong attention to details, and problem solving and time management skills. Furthermore, you should be result driven and motivated by solving challenging situations, be able to communicate clearly with various stakeholders and act as a strong motivator and team player. We are also looking for an indivdual that can continuously evaluate and improve our and own work processes.

     Why SAS?  

At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including: 




    Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.   




    Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.   




    Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.   

      Additional information  

•    Deadline for application: 31.07.26.•    Desired start date: 01.10.26.•    The position will be starting with a probation period of 6 months.•    A background check will be conducted at the final stage of this recruitment process, as this role is security classified. If you are aware of any specific matters that may come up during this background check, we kindly ask you to be transparent about them during the recruitment process.







If you have questions about this position, you are welcome to contact Carlos D. Deutman, NPCT SAS Link, via email: Carlos.DiazDeutman@sas.se

title: BSP Prequalification Lead
description:
BSP Prequalification Lead

About Evora Labs

Evora Labs develops technology for the operation, integration, and management of battery energy storage systems and other distributed energy assets.

Our platform helps energy asset owners integrate assets, achieve market readiness, maintain operational availability, and manage technical requirements across energy markets and grid services.

About the role

As Asset Prequalification & Operations Lead, you will be responsible for managing the prequalification of energy assets for participation in ancillary services and other electricity-market services.

You will also support the integration, commissioning, and operation of battery energy storage systems (BESS), working across technical systems, grid requirements, asset owners, technology suppliers, and market participants.

The position combines energy-market prequalification, technical asset operations, BESS integration, project coordination, and continuous improvement of operational processes.

Key responsibilities

    Manage end-to-end prequalification processes for battery energy storage systems and other flexible energy assets.
    Coordinate with transmission system operators, grid operators, balance service providers, optimizers, asset owners, EPCs, and equipment suppliers during qualification and integration processes.
    Prepare technical documentation, test documentation, operational procedures, and supporting material required for asset qualification.
    Support commissioning, integration, and operational readiness of BESS projects.
    Monitor and support the operation of live energy assets.
    Investigate operational issues, alarms, communication problems, control-system issues, and asset-performance deviations.
    Support troubleshooting and coordination of corrective actions together with customers, suppliers, and technical teams.
    Support the integration of battery management systems, power conversion systems, energy management systems, meters, controllers, and other site equipment.
    Support communication and data integration between energy assets, control systems, optimizers, and external platforms.
    Contribute technical expertise during customer discovery and pre-sales activities.
    Develop and improve processes for prequalification, commissioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operation of energy assets.
    Support customers and partners throughout asset onboarding, qualification, commissioning, and ongoing operation.
    Support technical sales discussions with customers and partners.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone with a strong technical background in energy systems and practical experience working with battery energy storage systems or other distributed energy resources.

You should have:

    University degree in energy engineering, electrical engineering, power systems, automation, or a related technical field.
    Professional experience within the energy sector.
    Experience with battery energy storage systems (BESS), ancillary services, balancing markets, grid services, or asset prequalification.
    Experience coordinating or executing technical testing and commissioning activities.
    Experience with BESS integration, EMS, controllers, PCS, BMS, meters, or similar energy systems.
    Ability to interpret technical documentation, specifications, test requirements, and operational data.
    Experience troubleshooting technical and operational issues affecting energy assets.
    Ability to coordinate activities across customers, suppliers, technical teams, and external stakeholders.

Meritorious experience

It is considered an advantage if you have experience with:

    Nordic ancillary-service markets.
    FCR, aFRR, mFRR, or similar balancing services.
    SCADA, IoT, edge controllers, APIs, or remote-monitoring systems.
    Development of operational software or digital tools for energy assets.

Personal profile

You are technically hands-on and comfortable taking ownership of complex energy projects from qualification and integration through ongoing operation.

You work systematically, document technical work carefully, and are comfortable investigating problems across hardware, software, communications, and energy-market requirements.

You can work independently while coordinating closely with customers, technology providers, grid stakeholders, and software-development teams.

Because Evora is an early-stage technology company, you should also be comfortable working in an environment where processes are continuously developed and where technical experience from real projects is used directly to improve the product.

What we offer

You will join Evora Labs at an early stage and take a central role in developing how distributed energy assets are qualified, integrated, and operated.

The position provides the opportunity to work directly with battery energy storage projects, energy-market participation, asset operations, and the development of software and automation tools for the energy industry.

The role is based in Stockholm, with travel to customer and project sites when required.

title: Key Account Manager, Powerbox

We deliver innovative and reliable custom solutions across diverse industries, from medical technology and railway applications to defense and industrial automation. With a commitment to constant development and a focus on building strong client partnerships, Powerbox offers a dynamic and rewarding work environment.

Job description

Responsibility and tasks

    Identify and pursue sales opportunities, driving revenue growth.

    A deep understanding of power conversion and its applications.

Personality

To be successful in the role we believe you:

    Are a strategic thinker with the ability to identify opportunities and develop innovative solutions.

As a Key Account Manager, you'll lead sales efforts in the Swedish market, engage in challenging projects that drive our company's success. We provide competitive compensation packages, including salary, benefits, and incentives, to attract and retain top talent in the industry. With a strong emphasis on work-life balance, we offer flexible arrangements to ensure your well-being both inside and outside of work. Our culture is rooted in excellence, empowering you to excel in your role and contribute to our continuous growth and success. Take this chance to be part of a team dedicated to innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Researcher Electric Power Systems
employer: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB
description:
Are you driven by research, innovation, and excited about challenges in the Swedish and European electric power systems? Are you analytical, inquisitive, and enjoying meeting new people? Then we have a position for you!

About Us At the Electric Power Systems unit, our project portfolio consists of research and innovation projects that combine technical perspectives - how electric power systems should be built, managed, and operated - and economic perspectives, including the development of the electricity market, regulation, and policy issues. In addition to our research projects, we also handle various customer assignments. Our projects range from short-term to multi-year engagements, often in collaboration with colleagues from other units within RISE as well as external national or international partners.

Our team comprises 14 researchers, engineers, and project managers who enjoy collaborating. We represent several different nationalities, and our projects extend both within and outside Sweden's borders. Half of the team is based in Gothenburg and the other half in Stockholm. The location for this position is either Gothenburg or Stockholm.

About the Electric Power System The electric power system plays a central role in the transformation of the Swedish energy system. A key factor driving this is the electrification of the industrial and transport sectors. RISE contributes to this development with analyses and solutions through creating and executing research, innovation, and development projects in collaboration with companies, universities, institutes, and the public sector.

About the Role We are now looking for an experienced researcher who wants to help strengthen RISE's ability to execute, create, and drive projects that address the challenges of electric power system stability and resilience.

Being a part of such projects offers an opportunity to get involved in a wide range of tasks, including:

- Ideas creation through individual and team work – which problems are relevant?

- Method development – how to solve the problem?

- Project application development – how to attract experts around the formalized project idea and obtain the funding for it?

- Power systems modeling and simulation – how to design relevant test systems and execute adequate simulations?

- Detailed analysis of the observed simulation or analytical results – why do we get certain results and which ones are relevant?

- Project management – how to organize the project resources?

- Reporting results – how to adequately document the results through writing technical reports and scientific articles?

- Networking and presenting through various meetings, seminars, conferences, etc. - how to spread the important results and messages?

The role provides opportunities to delve into new areas and develop project ideas and collaborations to improve both the short- and long-term technical functionality of the power system, enabling the green energy transition.

Who Are You? As a person, you are analytical, creative, and open to new challenges. Being able to independently carry out tasks and projects comes naturally to you. The work will involve a variety of contacts with external project partners and customers, so it is important that you are outgoing and enjoy working in a customer-oriented manner.

You have a good understanding of future societal challenges and various stakeholders, as well as the need for research and innovation that exists now and in the future regarding the electric power system.

Requirements:

• Academic power systems degree and experience (1. or 2.):

1. PhD (or will defend your dissertation within the next 6 months)

2. MSc with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience

• Power System Stability expertise: In-depth knowledge in electric power systems with a specific focus on the domain of stability and control. Particularly, it is required to have an exceptional understanding of the system dynamics and state-of-the-art challenges and opportunities under significant penetration of inverter-based technology. It is a big plus if a person has domain knowledge of modeling and stability analyses of HVDC, FACTS, BESS, and RES systems.

• Simulation tools: Experience with power system simulation tools and working on different RMS and/or EMT studies through academic and commercial software. Experience with software such as PowerFactory, PSSE, PSCAD, MATLAB (Simulink), EMTP is desirable and a big plus. Additionally, experience with real-time simulations is advantageous.

• Soft skills: Good communication and presentation skills in English. The ability to engage in discussions in creating and constructively evaluating project ideas and results.

• Programming: Experience in utilizing programming languages (e.g. Python, MATLAB, Julia, C++, etc.) for better work efficiency, presentation of results, and automation of processes for various stability and dynamic performance studies, and optimization of power system operation and control.

description:
Are you an experienced Commissioning Engineer with strong expertise in low-voltage systems? Take a key role in large-scale data center projects, combining advanced testing and troubleshooting with technical leadership on site.

As a Commissioning Engineer, you will lead and execute the commissioning of low-voltage systems in large-scale data center projects.     Lead and execute L2–L4 commissioning activities for LV switchgear and electrical distribution systems

We are looking for

    Several years of hands-on experience in commissioning LV switchgear and low-voltage systems
    Strong ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) and wiring diagrams
    Experience with protection relays and protection testing, such as SEL, Basler or Woodward
    Experience performing primary and secondary injection testing
    Experience with EPMS coordination and testing, including point-to-point checks and system validation
    Experience in testing and troubleshooting LV switchgear and related components
    Professional proficiency in English, as it is used in daily communication
    Fluent english

It is meritorious if you have

    Experience with Schneider Electric low-voltage products and LV switchgear
    Experience with Schneider Electric circuit breakers, such as the NW and NS series
    Experience with Schneider Micrologic trip units, such as 5.0P/5.0E
    Experience with PQ power meters, such as the PQM8000 series
    Experience with UPS systems
    Experience with busduct systems
    Experience with commissioning in data centers or other mission-critical environments

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:

    Technical, solution-oriented and confident in independently driving complex commissioning activities on site.

Established in 1980, the British International School of Stockholm (BISS) is an all-through international school with a vibrant community of students from over 50 countries aged 3-18 years. Situated in the Danderyds Kommun area, BISS has two campuses: Altorp (Östra Valhallavägen 17, Djursholm), which hosts students from nursery to Year 4, and Ekeby (Rinkebyvägen 4, Danderyd), which hosts students from Year 5 to Year 13.

Like our student body, BISS employees come from many different countries and a rich range of backgrounds. Our vision is to empower people to be their best and we strongly believe in this not only for our students, but for our staff as well. title: Lead Project Manager Vehicle

title: Change Lead for SAP Implementation
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will play a key role in a major SAP transformation where success depends not only on the system itself, but on how well the organization is prepared to adopt new processes and ways of working. In this role, you act as the local bridge between a central transformation program and the business, turning overall direction into practical change activities that create readiness, engagement, and confidence.

You will work closely with managers, key users, process representatives, and central change teams to make sure the local organization is aligned, informed, and ready for go-live and the transition that follows. This is an exciting opportunity to influence how SAP-enabled ways of working are introduced and embedded in daily operations.

Job Description

    You will act as the primary local change representative for the SAP implementation.
    You will connect the central transformation program with local business stakeholders and translate program direction into relevant local actions.
    You will assess and document business impacts related to new processes, roles, and system capabilities.
    You will develop and drive local change plans in line with the overall program framework.
    You will coordinate communication activities that keep stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned throughout the transformation.
    You will identify stakeholder groups, understand their change needs, and support managers in leading their teams through the transition.
    You will plan and coordinate readiness activities and follow up on organizational preparedness.
    You will work with training teams and key users to coordinate end-user training activities.
    You will monitor adoption risks, resistance, and barriers to implementation, and raise critical issues when needed.
    You will provide status updates and readiness reporting to project and business leadership.

Requirements

    Experience in change management, project coordination, transformation programs, or similar roles.
    Proven experience supporting organizational change initiatives in complex environments.
    Experience coordinating communication, engagement, readiness, and training activities.
    Experience working closely with business stakeholders across multiple organizational levels.
    Good understanding of change management methodologies and best practices.
    Professional proficiency in English.

Nice to have

    Experience from large-scale ERP, digital transformation, or business transformation programs.
    Experience with SAP implementations or similar ERP platforms.
    Swedish language skills.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: IT Manager Engine and Fuel system Assembly
description:
IT Manager Engine and Fuel system Assembly

Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Role Summary

Are you ready to lead and innovate at the intersection of IT and production? Join Scania as an IT Manager for Engine & Fuel system Assembly and drive our transformation journey!

In this role, you will be an integral part of both the IT and production unit management teams. You will contribute to setting the direction and strategic plan for both IT and the production unit and implement it. You will also support the production unit in their transformation journey, driving and supporting both management teams to ensure continuous development. You and your team will be responsible for securing daily operations and maintaining the current IT landscape lifecycle.

Job Responsibilities

    Strategic Development: Actively contribute to and focus on cross-collaboration and strategic development within both IT and production management teams.
    Vision and Direction: Contribute to both IT and the production unit vision, creating prerequisites for a flow-oriented way of working that improves day-to-day deliveries and secures the cross-functional E2E perspective.
    Digital Solutions: Proactively identify business needs and translate them into digital solutions.
    Team Leadership: Coach the team, inspire continuous improvement, and ensure the team's competence development in new technologies.
    Cost Management: Actively challenge IT costs to ensure maximum value.

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced manager with relevant education and experience in production and/or IT. You should have a deep understanding of direction, be able to explain the "why," transform in the desired direction and drive game-changing assignments. As a servant leader, you value agility, innovation, and collaboration. You have proven skills in building relationships both internally and externally and see collaboration as the key to success. Your ability to see beyond the present and plan for the future is essential. You take an active role in improvement work and secure a game-changer mindset. You are open to change, take initiative, and drive the organization forward with Scania's goals and values as benchmarks. You believe in a learning organization and create conditions for the team to grow and develop.

At Scania, we believe embracing AI is essential for our continued growth and innovation. We are committed to provide our employees with the latest AI tools and fostering an environment where AI skills are encouraged. You don’t need prior experience with AI – but we expect curiosity, openness and a positive attitude towards learning and applying AI in your role.

This Is Us

Today, we are a section with 6 team where 5 of the teams are in Södertälje and 1 in Luleå. We are now searching for our new colleague who is curious to take on this challenging and exiting position as IT manager for the Engine and Fuel system assembly team.

The team responsible for IT deliveries within the Engine and Fuel system assembly, have many ongoing and upcoming initiatives driven by new business models and Industry 4.0. We will also implement a new ERP system to modernize our system landscape and support the growing business demands. This requires an experienced manager who has the ability and motivation to manage a complex IT delivery, which takes place both locally and globally. To secure the high load of IT demands, the IT delivery have both own IT development and managed service set ups.

Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic, flexible workplace with hybrid work options, including Scania Sergel and Midway hubs. With a structured development plan and courses, Scania supports your career growth both locally and internationally. Benefits include training at our health center Gröndal or wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible hours, and company car leasing. Scania also hosts events for employees and their families, and Stockholm residents enjoy direct access to Södertälje via Scania Job express buses.

Application

Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes. Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-28. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

title: Postdoc position in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence subject (RAI) (http://www.ltu.se/robotics) at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a Postdoc contributing to our growing activities. The RAI team are conducting fundamental research in all the aspects of robotics with a specific focus on Aerial and Space robotics.

The vision of RAI is aiming in closing the gap from theory to real life, while the team has a strong expertise in field robotics. Specific application areas of focus are robotics for mines, construction sites, aerial inspection of aging infrastructure, multi-robotic search and rescue, multi sensorial fusion and multirobot coordination, including multirobot perception, decentralization and mission execution.

The RAI team has a strong European participation in multiple R&D&I projects, while RAI was also participating in the DARPA SUB-T challenge with the CoSTAR Team lead by NASA/JPL (https://costar.jpl.nasa.gov/).

Subject description

Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.

Project description

The research topic is in the area of Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. More specifically, the position will involve dense research activities in the area of designing, experimenting and theoretical development with the following combined research areas. Previous experience in one or preferably more topics from these areas is considered a merit.

    5G reconfigurable Connectivity
    5G/6G QoS
    Control of Communication networks
    Markovian Processes
    Network Based Localisation / Radio based connectivity
    Adaptive bandwidth
    Mesh networking
    Wireless Sensor Networks
    Edge Computing
    Time Delayed Systems
    Adaptive Queuing

Duties

The duties of a Postdoc primarily comprise research. You will perform research with substantial experimental components that should be published in peer-reviewed international journals and at major conferences. The position will include supervision of PhD and MSc students, teaching and supporting in acquiring funds for future research projects from research funding agencies/councils, EU framework program or industry.

Qualifications

In order to be eligible for employment as post doctor you must have a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in Automatic control or related subject. A doctoral degree awarded no more than three years before the application deadline provides a useful qualification. Candidates who have been awarded a doctoral degree at an earlier date may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example, different types of statutory leave of absence.

The research tasks require a solid mathematical background with proven advanced experimental capabilities and excellent programming skills (e.g. C++, ROS, Matlab, etc.). You should have a strong vision to evaluate and demonstrate the research findings in real life operating conditions, in an approach to close the gap between pure theory and experimental verifications. You will need to represent the group in different contexts, both in Sweden and abroad and hence have excellent skills in English.

Further information

The employment is limited to 2 years with possibility to be extended 1 year.

title: Temporary substitute Bioinformatician at the UPSC Bioinformatics Platform
description:
Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology

The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.

About the position

The Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC) is a world-leading research center in plant physiology and forest genetics. Its research activities generate large volumes of data that require bioinformatics resources and software for analysis. UPSC is a collaboration between the Department of Plant Physiology at Umeå University and the Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU). Within SLU, a university-wide infrastructure currently provides bioinformatics support: the SLU Bioinformatics Infrastructure (SLUBI). As SLUBI will be phased out by the end of 2026, a bioinformatics position is being established within the UPSC Bioinformatics Platform (UPSCb). UPSCb is part of the broader bioinformatics environment in Umeå, most of which is co-located with UPSC, comprising more than thirty professionals working for both local and national organizations (for example, SciLifeLab NBIS).

In your role within the UPSC Bioinformatics Platform (UPSCb), you will provide bioinformatics support and services to research groups and participate in a variety of projects. The position involves managing several projects simultaneously. Projects are typically short-term, lasting a few months, and often require close collaboration with biologists. To ensure that data analyses carried out within the platform maintain a high standard, you will participate in bioinformatics seminars every other week and take part in the platform's study sessions once a week. The platform supports participation in courses and workshops for professional development and is also involved in delivering such training at both local and national levels. You can expect to work on short, challenging projects in a supportive and dynamic work environment and, over time, take responsibility for the analysis of multiple research projects.

Your profile

We are looking for candidates who hold a PhD in computational biology, bioinformatics, or a related field. You should be highly familiar with Unix/Linux and at least one programming language such as Python, R, C, or C++. Strong collaboration skills and excellent English proficiency are required. UPSC is an international environment, and the position requires a strong ability to interact with biologists, who make up the primary user group of the UPSC Bioinformatics Platform (UPSCb). UPSCb also provides user support, in some cases over extended periods and for more comprehensive projects. Therefore, previous experience in supervision, mentoring, or teaching is considered an advantage. As you will be an important member of the UPSC Bioinformatics Platform, a small unit consisting of five employees, you must demonstrate a strong ability to independently organize, manage, and report your work.

You will work alongside other experts within the platform and the broader bioinformatics community, who are often highly specialized in specific technologies such as RNA-Seq, metagenomics, or epigenetics. Therefore, experience in processing and integrating multi-omics data (for example genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics) is considered meritorious. Population-related projects are also common, making experience with whole-genome studies and eQTL mapping an additional advantage.

About us

UPSC belongs to two universities, the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences and Umeå University. About 200 people from more than 40 different nationalities work here. We host some 30 principal investigators, and our researchers have access to state-of-the-art analytical platforms, unique tree germplasm resources and plant growth facilities. We strive for a collaborative work environment and support our scientists throughout all career stages by providing professional training opportunities and individual career mentoring.

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location:

Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology, SLU, Umeå.

Form of employment:

Temporary substitute employment 12 months

Scope:

100%

Start date:

As agreed.

Application:

Please submit your application before deadline 01 September 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

Union representatives:

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/





The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Group Manager – R&D Turbine Mechanical Integrity Rotor Components
description:
The R&D TURBINE department is growing and consequently we are expanding from five to six groups. We are now looking for you who have a high interest in becoming Group Manager leading our newly established team— Mechanical Integrity Rotor Components (MIR).

In this role, you will not be stepping into an isolated leadership position. On the contrary, you will become part of a supportive management team where collaboration, shared responsibility, and mutual support are fundamental. As a new Group Manager, you can expect strong backing from experienced colleagues across the department, creating a safe and encouraging environment for you to grow and succeed in your role.

A Snapshot of Your Day

As the manager of MIR, you will be part of a team responsible for the reliability of our high-loaded turbine rotor and hot gas components. The group are actively taking part in highly varied and challenging areas, such as technology & innovation, development of new and existing products, prototype testing, failure investigations, support to the workshop, procurement, and sales projects.

Your day will be a balanced mix of people leadership, technical direction, and strategic work. You will focus on developing and supporting your team and its individuals while at the same time contributing to department strategy, project planning, and continuous operational improvement.

A key part of your role is the close and structured collaboration with the Group Manager for Mechanical Integrity Stator Components (MIS). Together, you will work as a leadership pair with a shared responsibility for mechanical integrity, actively shaping how the two groups collaborate, align technologies, and develop common ways of working.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Foster a safe and inclusive work environment for all employees
    Short- and long-term development of group competence
    Ensure quality and efficient work practices
    Continuous improvements of tools, criteria and guidelines
    Plan and prioritize team activities supporting daily operations
    Represent MIR group in the department’s leadership team

What You Bring

    Genuine interest in people development and team building
    A willingness to work long-term with continuous improvements to achieve strategic goals
    Excellent communication skills
    Basic understanding of turbine function and application.
    Knowledge within the area of mechanical integrity and materials is a plus but not a requirement
    Proficiency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken

About the Team

The team currently consists of 8 permanent employees plus several consultants. The group is highly driven and innovative, at the absolute forefront within its area of responsibility, i.e. mechanical integrity, material development and material characterization. A typical task for a group member starts with stress/thermo-mechanical analysis as the basis for low cycle fatigue, creep, crack growth, and oxidation assessments. They work closely with teams that include senior MI engineers, designers, heat transfer engineers, and CFD engineers.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. title: Business Controller
description:
Scania Credit Group (SCA), one of the captive Scania Financial Services entities, offers financing and insurance in the Middle East, Central Asia, and West Africa. SCA has become a leader in factoring solutions for non-captive dealers and body-builders, supporting Scania's goal to reduce CCC and offload its balance sheet. We have partnered with external credit insurers to mitigate commercial and political risks in certain transactions. SCA is expanding into new markets, particularly in the AMC region.

Based in Södertälje, the SCA Head Office and Market Support Centre provides governance, strategic development, credit risk management, contract administration, and IT support. With 50 employees, including 30 in Södertälje, we manage around 250 MEUR of assets across 10+ markets.

At SCA we value team spirit, diversity and respect. We believe that every employee should be able to be themselves at work. Our corporate culture is characterized by respect for the individual, continuous improvement and always putting the customer first.  

Role Summary

Are you passionate about financial analysis, business partnering, and continuous improvement? Do you enjoy turning data into insights and contributing to business performance? Join our team as a Business Controller, where you will contribute to both day-to-day controlling activities and the continued evolution of our finance function.

This is a broad and engaging role where you will combine financial analysis and business controlling with process improvement and digitalization initiatives. As our business continues to grow, you will play an important role in strengthening reporting capabilities, enhancing finance processes, and providing insights that support better decision-making across the organization.

You will contribute to monthly closing and reporting activities, business planning, forecasting, and management reporting, while helping to build efficient and scalable ways of working for the future. The role offers broad exposure across finance and the opportunity to collaborate with stakeholders across multiple international markets.

Job Responsibilities

Main responsibilities include:

    Contribute to the monthly closing process together with the Finance team, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting
    Perform financial performance analysis, business follow-up, and forecast reporting to support informed decision-making
    Prepare, monitor, and follow up on budgets, forecasts, and long-term business plans
    Support Group reporting and help ensure high-quality financial reporting and compliance
    Prepare financial presentations, reporting material, and analyses for the Board, Regional Management, and Leadership Teams
    Collaborate closely with the Financial Controller to meet evolving reporting, governance, and compliance requirements
    Partner with the Business Controller on strategic initiatives, ad hoc analyses, and cross-functional projects that support business growth and continuous improvement
    Drive digitalization and automation initiatives within Finance to enhance reporting capabilities and ways of working
    Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, strengthen data quality, and support scalability
    Act as a key support for the organization regarding reporting guidelines, financial systems, and finance best practices
    Contribute to the development of controlling processes and internal controls as the business continues to grow



Who You Are

You enjoy working with numbers and transforming data into meaningful business insights, but you are equally motivated by improving processes and finding smarter ways of working. You are analytical, structured, and proactive, with the ability to balance attention to detail with a broader business perspective.

To succeed in this role, you:

    Hold a degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, combined with a few years' experience in Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, Financial Reporting, or a similar role
    Have experience in financial reporting, planning, forecasting, and analysis
    Are analytical, curious, and solution-oriented
    Have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating with stakeholders across functions
    Thrive in an international and dynamic business environment
    Are a team player who values knowledge sharing and collaboration
    Are fluent in English, both written and spoken
    Have excellent skills in Excel and PowerPoint
    Have experience with HFM, Power BI, or other finance systems (considered an advantage)



This Is Us

You'll be joining a Finance team of five colleagues based in Södertälje, where collaboration, trust, and knowledge sharing are at the heart of how we work. In this role, you will work closely with the Business Controller and Financial Controller, while partnering with colleagues across our international organization.

Our size allows for close collaboration, broad involvement across finance activities, and the opportunity to make a real impact. At the same time, our international presence provides exposure to colleagues and stakeholders across multiple markets and cultures.

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-28. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

description:

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Grabs

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH
